names: Mission Bay South Block 33 (unnamed UCSF building)
summary: This record's geometry is the north of two real, previously untracked UCSF buildings between 3rd and Illinois Streets, split from a single satellite-imagery fragment at a visible roofline gap; the same UCSF project that built the clinical building immediately south of it (this project's own mission_bay_block_34 record) also built a new Illinois Street Garage at 590 Illinois Street, described as sharing a block with the Valley Center for Vision to its north -- geographically the best match for this north building, though no address-linked primary source confirms the pairing.

milestones.text: Construction begins on the combined Bayfront Medical Building and Illinois Street Garage project, per UCSF Real Estate's own project page -- probable identity of this record's building (see open_questions); the clinical building's own construction start is separately dated October 2, 2021 by SF YIMBY (see the neighboring mission_bay_block_34 record), so this April 2021 date most likely reflects earlier garage or site work rather than the clinic

Illinois Street Garage (590 Illinois St), 9 stories / 500 spaces, opens as part of UCSF's Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage project -- probable identity of this record's building, inferred from its position immediately north of the clinical building this project also built (see open_questions)

sources.title: Bayfront Medical Building and Illinois Street Garage (project page: Illinois Street Garage, 590 Illinois St, 9 stories / 500 spaces, opened May 15, 2023; on the same block as the Wayne and Gladys Valley Center for Vision at 490 Illinois St)

open_questions: This record's own geometry file states the building's name/address/operator are not confirmed by any source checked in the geometry-correction pass. This research pass found a strong but not fully confirmed candidate: UCSF's Illinois Street Garage (590 Illinois St), the parking-garage half of the same 'Block 34 Clinical Building and Parking Garage' project whose clinical building this project identifies as the neighboring mission_bay_block_34 record. The garage is described in UCSF's own project page as on the same block as 490 Illinois St (north of the clinic, which sits at the 3rd/Mariposa corner to the south) -- matching this record's position as the NORTH of the two split buildings. No source directly ties an address to this record's own OCII plan-block-33 parcel number, so the identification is geographic inference, not confirmed by an address-to-parcel source.

If this identification is correct, exact spaces/levels may not match this record's own traced footprint precisely (the garage is described as attached to/adjoining the clinical building rather than as a fully freestanding structure); this record's geometry was derived independently via the real-gap-fragment technique and was not re-traced against this new information.
Cost of the garage alone (vs. the combined ~$335.8M clinical-building-plus-garage project figure reported elsewhere) was not found.

2026-09-21 pass: added an April 2021 construction-start milestone from UCSF Real Estate's own combined project page for 'Bayfront Medical Building and Illinois Street Garage.' This is a combined-project date covering both buildings, not a garage-specific one; direct confirmation that the garage itself (rather than the clinical building) broke ground in April 2021 specifically was not found in this pass.
